info.title: Kejue Public API
info.description:
The Kejue Public API lets you programmatically create calls, manage campaigns, and retrieve call results.

## Authentication

All requests require an API key passed in the `X-API-Key` header:

```
X-API-Key: kej_live_...
```

API keys are scoped to a workspace. Create and manage keys from the Kejue dashboard under **Settings → API Keys**.

## Base URL

```
https://api.kejue.co/api/v1
```

## Rate Limits

API requests are rate-limited per workspace. If you exceed the limit you'll receive a `429 Too Many Requests` response.

## Errors

All error responses follow a consistent format:

```json
{
  "error": "Human-readable message",
  "code": "ERROR_CODE",
  "details": {}
}
```

post.description:
Create a call using this agent's full configuration.

Inherits all settings (prompt, voice, tools, call window, retry, etc.)
from the agent. Optional ``config`` overrides take highest priority.

Equivalent to ``POST /persona-calls`` with ``persona_id`` set to this
agent's ID.

Create a single outbound call.

Pass either ``contact_id`` for an existing contact, or ``contact`` to
create a new contact inline.  Country, timezone, and language are
auto-deduced from the phone number when not provided.

Dynamic variables can be passed via ``context`` — they are rendered into
the agent's prompt using ``{{variable_name}}`` syntax.

get.description:
List calls with optional filters.

Supports simple filters (status, contact_id, campaign_id, source) and
advanced filtering via the ``filters`` query parameter (JSON-encoded
array of filter rules).
Get full call details including transcript, summary, recording, and more.

post.description:
Inject context into a live call.

Sends a message to the AI agent during an active call. The agent receives
it as additional context and can act on it naturally within the conversation.

**Urgency levels:**
- ``immediate`` — interrupts the current conversation
- ``soon`` — delivers at the next natural pause
- ``later`` — passive context the agent incorporates when relevant

Create a new campaign.

Supports all-in-one creation: pass ``contact_ids`` to add contacts and
``auto_start`` / ``scheduled_start_at`` to start the campaign in a single
request.

post.description:
Create a call with the full persona configuration pre-loaded.

Applies the complete settings hierarchy:
**System Defaults → Workspace → Persona → API Overrides**

All persona tools (in-call and post-call), tags, scoring criteria,
structured data extraction, call windows, retry schedules, and webhooks
are inherited automatically. Optional ``config`` overrides are applied
on top as the highest priority.

SystemParameterInput.title: SystemParameterInput
SystemParameterInput.description:
A parameter whose value is injected by the system at runtime (hidden from the AI).

System parameters are resolved from the execution context (e.g. call_id, contact_id).
Unlike dynamic parameters, they are never exposed to the AI model.
Unlike static parameters, their values are not fixed — they change per call/conversation.

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Create and manage AI agents (personas). Each agent has a name, prompt, voice configuration, and optional tools. Agents are the core building block — attach voice configs, tools, and use them to make calls.

tags.name: Calls
tags.description: Create outbound calls, retrieve call details and transcripts, and list calls with filtering. Each call is associated with a contact and optionally an agent and campaign.

tags.name: Persona Calls
tags.description: Create calls with the full agent configuration pre-loaded. Applies the complete settings hierarchy (workspace → agent → campaign → overrides) with all agent tools, tags, scoring, and webhooks inherited automatically.

tags.name: Contacts
tags.description: Create and manage contacts. Contacts represent the people your agents call. Each contact has a phone number, name, and optional metadata. Supports single creation, bulk import, and CSV upload.

tags.name: Campaigns
tags.description: Create and manage calling campaigns. Campaigns let you batch-call a list of contacts with shared settings, scheduling, and retry logic.

tags.name: Tools
tags.description:
Create and manage custom HTTP tools that agents can invoke during calls. Tools let agents fetch data, trigger actions, or integrate with external systems mid-conversation.

Each tool supports three parameter types:
- **Dynamic parameters** — filled by the AI at runtime (visible to the AI)
- **Static parameters** — fixed values sent with every invocation (hidden from the AI)
- **System parameters** — values injected from the execution context at runtime, such as `call_id`, `contact_id`, or `workspace_id` (hidden from the AI)

tags.name: Voices
tags.description: List available voices for use in agent voice configurations.

tags.name: Phone Numbers
tags.description: List phone numbers available in your workspace for making outbound calls.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Create and manage webhook subscriptions. Receive real-time notifications for call events (started, ended, etc.) at your specified URL.

tags.name: Models
tags.description: List available AI models for use in agent voice configurations.
